==Summary==

{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

Rand is distracted by [[Min]] who is snuggled against him on the bed, wondering if he can keep her safe and keep [[Elayne]] and [[Aviendha]] safe also. [[Lews Therin]] is making comments inside his head making Rand wonder just how mad he is now. [[Logain Ablar]] and [[Davram Bashere]] have arrived with some [[Saldaea|Saldaean]] horse and other ''[[Asha'man]]''. Logain used [[Warder|Warders]] of some of the [[Aes Sedai|Sisters]] with Rand to track his location. There is a storm outside with lightning and heavy rain. Rand thinks of [[Mat]] and sees a man on a wagon. [[Loial]] was also part of the group that arrived and Min rushes to greet him. Rand seizes ''[[saidin]]'' and marvels that it now clean from the channeling he did at [[Shadar Logoth]] though he still feels the sickness and doesn't know why. Loial is pleased that there are [[Ogier]] rooms in the manor house so he will be able to sleep in a bed large enough for him. Loial and [[Karldin Manfor]] have visited all the ''[[Stedding|steddings]]'', except Shangtai, to warn the Ogier that [[Shadowspawn]] have been using the [[Ways]] and they should guard the [[Waygate|Waygates]]. Thankfully, most agreed to do so. Loial still worries about his mother, [[Covril]], catching up with him, along with his bride-to-be, [[Erith]]. Loial then tells Rand that the Aes Sedai that came with Logain and the Asha'man have been bonded by the men.

{{pov|[[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]]}}

Cadsuane is upset on learning that the Asha'man have bonded Aes Sedai. Cadsuane orders [[Samitsu Tamagowa]] to return to [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]] to keep an eye on [[Sashalle Anderly]] and the other Sisters in the city.

{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

Rand is angry with Logain over the bonding of Aes Sedai since he doesn't want a war with the [[The White Tower|White Tower]]. He demands that no more bonding occur, but Logain explains [[Mazrim Taim|Taim]] gave the order, so they assumed it came from him. Logain adds that Taim does many things that people presume are at Rand's command, then advises Rand to give attention to the [[Black Tower]], saying Taim has more power with the Asha'man than Rand does since most of them have never even seen him. Logain also informs Rand that all of the Asha'man Rand kept with him are on the list of deserters, including [[Damer Flinn]], [[Jahar Narishma]], and [[Karldin Manfor]].

[[Bashere]] tells Rand of the men who ransacked his tent, similar to the men who nearly killed [[Dobraine]]. He believes the men were looking for the three [[Seven Seals|seals]] on the [[Dark One]]'s prison in Rand's possession. Rand decides to send Logain, Bashere, and Loial to the [[Seanchan]] to arrange a truce since he can't simultaneously fight them and prepare for the [[Last Battle]].

{{pov|[[Elza Penfell]]}}

Elza receives a report on what is happening in Cairhien from her Warder [[Fearil]]. [[Green Ajah|Greens]] usually have more than one Warder but she never has since finding a [[Darkfriend]] is a challenge. Elza orders him to protect the Dragon Reborn since Rand has to reach [[Last Battle|Tarmon Gai'don]] in order to be defeated by the Great Lord.
